XMM-Newton is a space observatory built by Airbus Defence and Space in Europe. ESA's flagship X-ray observatory. In service since 1999.
Dark-energy survey across one third of the sky
Infrared Great Observatory; 16 years of data
One of NASA's four Great Observatories
Iconic visible/UV space telescope; 5 servicing missions

ESA's X-ray multi-mirror mission. 3 telescopes in one spacecraft. Like Chandra, uses a highly elliptical orbit to escape Earth's radiation. Over 1,000 peer-reviewed papers published from its data. Launched the same year as Chandra — two observatories, two continents, the same invisible sky.
